title: Windowed primer sampler and slowpath signal annotator
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a new windowed workload sampler and a slowpath annotator reporter for latency root-cause analysis. No public API breaking changes.
description: Motivation: intermittent microbursts and KV-cache churn are causing reproducible but low-frequency slowpaths that our current session replayers smooth over. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: a windowed primer sampler (a runner that replays realistic request windows with configurable sliding/overlap semantics and deterministic seeding) and a slowpath signal annotator (a reporter that enriches traces with per-kernel invocation metadata and a synthesized 'slowpath_score'). Goals: 1) make small, transient slowpath regressions visible in aggregated bench runs; 2) provide actionable annotations linking tail latency spikes to kernel-level events and cache-priming status. Summary of changes: implemented windowed_sampler.py (new runner with YAML-driven profiles and seed control), added slowpath_annotator.go (exporter that consumes bench traces and emits annotated CSV/Parquet summaries plus a compact JSON summary used by downstream dashboards), added deterministic primer harness to utils/primer.py, extended CI bench matrix to include a 'windowed' workload permutation, added unit+integration tests and a lightweight fixture dataset under testdata/windowed-primer. Checklist: - [x] Feature implementation - windowed sampler and annotator - [x] Deterministic seeding and config validation - [x] Minimal end-to-end integration test - [x] Bench CI job and flamegraph smoke test - [x] Documentation: README and example config. Context/links: Related internal investigation ENG-3456 (kernel-slew tail events); proto spec for annotator: docs/bench/slowpath-annotator.md. Usage notes: runner supports run-length, window-size, overlap, primer_strategy (none|kv|kv-full), and seed parameters. Annotator outputs per-window metrics: p50/p95/p99, slowpath_count, avg_kernel_dur_ms, primer_hit_rate, slowpath_score (0..1). Backward compatibility: runner sits behind existing harness and can be enabled via bench config; annotator is an opt-in reporter and does not alter raw traces.
commits: 1) Add windowed_sampler runner and config parser (Aisha Patel) 2) Implement slowpath_annotator reporter with CSV/Parquet export (Aisha Patel) 3) Primer utility and deterministic seed support (tests + docs) 4) Add integration tests and CI bench matrix step 5) Fix flakiness: reduce non-deterministic timers in test harness
review_comments: Diego: Please make the default seed explicit and add a short note about cross-run comparability. Priya: The slowpath_score heuristic looks useful but we should log intermediate signals for debug; asked for an additional CSV column and sample size caps. Eleanor: small style nits in Go reporter + requested an integration smoke test in the bench CI matrix. Author replies: added explicit seed=42 default, added intermediate signal columns (kernel_invocations, cache_miss_ratio) and capped sample aggregation at 10k events per window; fixed Go linter comments. CI: initial CI run showed a flaky flamegraph smoke on alpine runner (timeout), increased timeout and re-ran; second run passed. Approvals: Diego approved after seed fix; Priya approved after intermediate signals added; Eleanor approved after lint fixes.
merge_outcome: Squash and merge by Aisha Patel. Commit message abbreviated to 'windowed sampler + slowpath annotator: enable windowed bench runs and annotate slowpath signals for kernel/caching diagnostics'.
notes_for_release: Bench feature: windowed workload runner and slowpath annotator are enabled under the benchmark lab harness. To opt in, add 'runner: windowed' and 'reporters: [slowpath_annotator]' to bench config. Outputs: annotated CSV/Parquet in bench-exports/<run-id>/slowpath/ and compact JSON summary for dashboards.
postmerge_actions: - Monitor nightly bench runs for spike in slowpath_score - Add a Grafana panel that uses compact JSON summaries (follow-up ENG-3521) - Ship a small sample dataset to perf-team for review
notes: This PR focuses on observability of transient slowpaths rather than mitigation. Follow-up work will explore automated primer tuning and server-side adaptive priming policies.
changelog_entries: Added windowed sampler runner to generate overlapping request windows for better microburst detection
Added slowpath signal annotator reporter that enriches bench traces with kernel-level annotations and exports CSV/Parquet summaries
Updated CI bench matrix to include windowed workload permutation and flamegraph smoke tests
